purpose: Determine whether MLP4--5 or MLP6--7 implements the dominant MLP4--7 source interactions read by MLP8, while retaining embedding, attention, and MLP0--3 as live causal contexts.

parent.finding: MLP4--7 is the stable dominant depth family for parent M, EM, and AM aggregates, but singular-to-plural full response retains a large MLP0--3 by MLP4--7 interaction.

novelty_audit.relation: No canonical Task14 result causally splits MLP4--7 at raw pre-MLP8 input.
This earlier depth split intervened at the later pre-attention-11 current-value input and did not preserve MLP8 source interactions.
Older MLP4/5 versus MLP6/7 work concerns equality/compression objects, not this Task14 causal computation.

data.row_builder: unchanged fresh matched-natural Task14 HOLDOUT rows
data.disclosure: All parent E/A/U/V results are open. Only the MLP4--5 versus MLP6--7 refinement and its outcomes are prospective.

exact_input_partition.corner: For each subset of E,A,U,W,X, use donor values for listed families and recipient values otherwise, then apply native MLP8 RMSNorm.
exact_input_partition.numerical_policy: Use authoritative parent U and V=W+X aggregates whenever a corner exactly matches a parent corner; construct W+X only for genuinely mixed W/X counterfactuals. Do not relax exactness bars.
exact_input_partition.operational_limit: Native writer groups are causal localization handles, not a unique semantic gauge.

conditions.opposite_number: 31 nonempty subsets times exact cross, quadratic, and full MLP8 response
conditions.same_number_lexical: the same 31 subsets and response pieces
conditions.downstream_background: standalone fixed L11H3 interface; all other MLP4--M10 slots remain recipient

causal_statistics.set_function: Complete 2^5 Boolean factorial scored by answer-directed margin and full-vocabulary CE.
causal_statistics.mobius: Compute every finite causal interaction over E,A,U,W,X and exactly aggregate them back to the parent E/A/U/V lattice.
causal_statistics.parent_closure: Regrouping W+X as V must reproduce every parent corner at raw input, RMSNorm input, MLP8 output, propagated slot, head output, CE, and margin.

predictions.pred_a_instrument_and_parent_closure: All exactness gates and every parent-regrouping closure gate pass.
predictions.pred_b_X_mlp6_7_dominant: X-containing refinements recover at least 70% of the parent V-centered M, EM, and AM aggregates in both metrics and directions, while corresponding W-only terms recover at most 25%.
predictions.pred_c_W_mlp4_5_dominant: The converse dominance criterion holds for W.
predictions.pred_d_distributed_within_V: Both W- and X-containing refinements recover at least 25% of a parent V-centered aggregate in both metrics and directions, and neither half dominates.
predictions.pred_e_WX_composition: Terms containing both W and X reach at least 25% of a parent V-centered aggregate in both metrics and directions.
predictions.pred_f_direction_switch: An identified dominant V half differs between plural-to-singular and singular-to-plural.
predictions.pred_g_number_specific: Every same-number lexical corner is at most 25% of the corresponding opposite-number full-source response scale.
